$note: Pricing + quota as DATA (T11.1) — the plan/quota axis of the ONE billing table. Resource-shape prices live in estimates/pricing.json (the PAYG infrastructure axis, T3.1); the two axes are disjoint (ADR-022/041 hybrid model) — no price appears in both. The estimate engine, quota evaluator (T11.5), and invoice generator (T11.3) read the plan/quota numbers HERE; a second copy of any of these constants is a bug (billing pack). Money is integer cents (ADR-025). Sources: F9 (feature-specs.md — Free 3 / Pro 5 / Business 20 seats; Pro $29 canonical per ADR-041; Business $99 = canon plan_fee_cents) and the shipped seat gate (identity/orgs.go). project_limit / included_seats: -1 = unlimited; enterprise seats 1000 matches the shipped SubscriptionInfo. Enterprise fee is custom (null). Per-plan EGRESS allowances are deferred to T11.5 (only the Business org's 100 GB is canon-pinned; Free/Pro are not sourced yet — do not invent them here). Per-ENVIRONMENT resource quota envelope (founder 2026-08-23, US-3.3e): free 1/2Gi/10Gi, pro 8/16Gi/100Gi, business 12/24Gi/200Gi, enterprise 16/32Gi/250Gi. Values are Kubernetes quantity strings and are the ONLY definition — the control plane resolves them and ships them to the cell in the desired doc, so the cell-agent never carries a copy of the plan table.

overage.$note: Soft-quota unit prices (F9 / billing pack). Plan-independent; charged beyond the plan's included allowance, only with confirm=true + shown price.

never_gated.$note: Plans gate capabilities, never safety (F9 / billing pack). This list is law; the quota evaluator (T11.5) consults IsNeverGated before any plan gate, and a test asserts the list is complete.
